release_requirements: A fresh independently accepted300-second host window and reviewed current process/file/ownership binding are still required before real CPU qualification. The completed07 window failed and supplies no numerical release.

Root must call ready_for_next_case against a current source-bound record before each case, bind covers_case to actual retained start/end times, and stop releasing further cases after any invalidation. A currently running child must be allowed to exit naturally; no force or automatic retry.

Root must bind the final supervision record and exact helper/source/input hashes into eventual matrix evidence. Source review does not turn sampled evidence into continuous certainty or authorize MLX/live deployment.
resolved_draft_findings: Explicit per-case interval and next-release freshness gates added
review_findings: The helper imports only exact hash-bound07 imports and four reviewed read-only AST functions; main does not start, stop, signal or retry qualification children.

It samples normal pressure, finite nonnegative swap at or below initial usage, absence of observed build/test processes, readiness/reservoir connectivity, exact identity/input bindings and positive gaps no greater than15s; any violation stays invalidated.

Zero-sample finish refuses. An exact owned finish request triggers a final health/identity sample, and final identity changes invalidate. Finite duration exhaustion invalidates rather than silently accepting incomplete coverage.
Stop input is bounded512bytes, regular, same-user, single-link, not group/world-writable and opened no-follow; exact schema/token/operation are required.

covers_case requires bracketing samples for the actual case interval and validates every retained sample; ready_for_next_case also requires running, at least two samples and latest-sample freshness no greater than15s.
Output is fresh/exclusive, durable atomic updates preserve raw samples and first invalidation; failures retain invalidated evidence. The module never enforces a process kill or chooses another case.
